title: Microsoft Viva: Interactive insights in Agent 365 Business Analytics
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly says Microsoft has not confirmed that Viva feature access management governs Interactive insights. Microsoft documents a User-level export and insights setting that restricts its responses to aggregated insights for leaders and managers when turned off; analysts are exempt. The cited navigation paths, PowerShell call and roadmap details are supported.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not confirmed that Viva Feature Access Management policies govern Interactive insights.
claims.quote: When off, leaders and managers can't export user-level data or view user-level insights on specific cards, and Interactive insights provides aggregated insights only.
claims.fix: Replace the unqualified applicability caveat in the row name, note, governance prose, rollout checklist and open question with: 'Microsoft documents User-level export and insights as controlling user-level insights from Interactive insights for leaders and managers: turning it off leaves aggregated insights only. The setting is always on for analysts and cannot be changed for that role. A dedicated Interactive insights enablement policy is not yet documented.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/insights/org-team-insights/export-copilot-metrics#admin-management. Keep the existing generic path and placeholder command; do not invent a feature ID.
